coverage: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:35 – 14:30) · Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:40) · Night Shift (22:40 – 06:30)

sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:35 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 4x keys, 2x swipe cards, 2x vests, 2x radios, 1x Ops phone, 2x cameras, 2x camera chargers. All photos/videos sent at the end of the shift report.
Charlie Route commenced. Welfare check at Starbucks. All clear.
Welfare check with Cotton On staff. Store not open but staff visible. No issues.
Welfare check at Localito Convenience Store and Daily Drip. All clear.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street, Timezone, 77 Convenience Store, and Mid City Shopping Centre. All clear. Presence maintained.
Patrols continued due to no activity occurring.
Welfare check at Remedy Coffee. No issues.
Welfare check at 24 Yes Convenience Store. All clear.
Arrived at Aotea Square check-in. Full sweep completed. No issues found. Presence maintained.
Departed area due to no activity or concerns.
Arrived at top of Mayoral Drive check-in. Scoped thoroughly. All clear.
Walkthrough along Wakefield Street to check for vagrants sleeping or causing issues. All clear.
Welfare check at Auckland Library. All clear.

Arrived at check-in, corner of Lorne Street and Wellesley Street. Scoped thoroughly. A few street persons present but not causing issues. Welfare checks along Lorne Street stores, businesses, and traffic control team. All clear.
Arrived at corner of Lorne Street and High Street. Welfare checks on all stores and businesses within High Street. All clear.
Arrived at Freyberg Place and Women's Memorial Hall. A few street persons present in their usual area but not causing issues. Water fountain and Metropolis Hotel area checked. All clear.
Arrived at Chancery Square check-in. Full sweep completed. All clear. Presence maintained.
Departed area due to no activity.
Arrived at Wilson Carpark check-in. Full sweep. Welfare checks on all stores and static guards. All clear.

Arrived at bottom of Fort Street check-in. Welfare checks at Sienna Cafe, Smiley, Char Grill, Auckland Harbour Suites, Giapo, and other stores. Char Grill reported a male individual had earlier been consuming alcohol on the public benches and yelling at customers. Guards maintained presence to monitor in case the POI returned.
Departed area due to no issues found.
Arrived at Kiwibank check-in. Checked in with the security guard. All clear. Welfare checks inside Mr Katsu, 77 Convenience Store, The Coffee Club, Tuck Shop, and St Pierre Sushi. All clear.
Welfare checks inside Four Square, Movenpick, and Adidas. All clear.
Welfare check inside McDonald's Britomart. All clear.
Arrived at Commercial Bay check-in. Full walkthrough completed. Welfare checks on stores. Heavy foot traffic observed. No issues visible. Presence maintained.
Welfare checks at Aotea Gifts and Metro Woolworths. All clear.
Welfare check at OK Gift Shop. All clear. Alpha Route commenced.
Arrived at check-in, corner of Albert Street and Customs Street. Scoped thoroughly. All clear.
Patrolling up Queen Street while checking in on static guards, stores, and businesses.
Arrived at corner of Queen Street and Shortland Street. No issues found. Stopped at Metro New World for a drink.
Arrived at the corner of Queen Street and Wyndham Street. Welfare checks completed, all clear:
Arrived at headquarters for morning interval.
Morning interval completed. Welfare checks completed, all clear:
Response call received from Lumi Cafe regarding several street vagrants sleeping next to the store.
Arrived at Lumi Cafe. Guards asked the group of POIs to move along; they complied.
Arrived at Elliott Street Apartments check-in. Welfare check inside Atrium on Elliott while heading towards Crowne Plaza Hotel. All clear.
Welfare checks at City Convenience Store and Mr Barber. All clear.
Arrived at top of Victoria Street check-in. Welfare checks on stores. No issues found. Presence maintained.
Patrolling up Federal Street with visible presence.
Arrived at corner of Federal Street and Wellesley Street. Checked thoroughly. All clear.
Arrived at corner of Albert Street and Wellesley Street. Welfare check with static guard at the new train station. All clear.
Arrived at Aotea Square check-in. Full sweep completed. All clear. Presence maintained.
Response call received from Lumi Cafe regarding two street vagrants sleeping in front of the store. Assistance requested to move them along.
Arrived at Lumi Cafe. Two street vagrants sleeping on a public bench. Staff advised guards were unable to move them as they were in a public space and not on Lumi Cafe property.
Response call received from Glassons regarding female individual Chuma Cheme inside the store acting aggressively. Assistance requested in case she escalated.
Arrived at Glassons. Presence maintained while POI remained inside and waited for staff updates.

Staff signalled that Chuma Cheme had store items. Guards stopped Chuma and requested the items back; she complied and left the store. Guards monitored her movements down Queen Street to ensure she did not enter or steal from other stores. (footage on file)
Security presence maintained at Mirrou as POI made her way down Lower Queen Street. Guards returned to headquarters to recharge the Ops phone.

Response call received from Nike regarding a female individual wearing black leggings and a brown jacket who placed an item into her jacket and left without purchasing. Staff confirmed the theft on CCTV after the alarm sounded. Incident occurred around 13:38. (photo on file)
Arrived at headquarters for lunch break while monitoring for further response calls.
Morning shift completed. Equipment handover completed.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:40)
items: Afternoon shift deployed. Equipment handover completed.
Arrived on site and debrief commenced.
Debrief completed. Team geared up and prepared to leave headquarters.
Welfare checks commenced along Queen Street, heading towards Aotea Square.
Welfare checks at Nike, Cotton On, Localito Convenience Store, Footlocker, Unichem Pharmacy, and McDonald's Queen Street. No issues to report.
Security presence maintained at 220 Queen Street after Nike confirmed the female vagrant involved in the earlier theft had been seen entering the building. Building sweep commenced.
Full sweep of 220 Queen Street completed. No sign of the vagrant. Guards stood down and resumed welfare checks along Queen Street towards Commercial Bay.
Welfare checks at Farmers, Vans, Peter Alexander, Glassons, and Dangerfield. No issues to report.
Welfare checks at UGG, Merchant, Lovisa, Novo, TechPro, Canterbury Arcade, Typo, Skechers, and Platypus. No issues to report.
Welfare checks at Mirrou, Pagani, Mountain Warehouse, Kiwiana, Omnitech, Oscar Wylee, Specsavers, Hallensteins, OPSM, and Chemist Warehouse. No issues to report.
Welfare checks at Kathmandu, Macpac, One NZ, JB Hi-Fi, Michael Hill, Partridge Jewellers, Pandora, ASB, and New World. No issues to report.
Lower Queen Street welfare sweep completed. No further issues. Heading to Commercial Bay.
Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart. No issues to report.
Full sweep along Commercial Bay and Commerce Street. All clear, no issues to report.
Welfare checks at Auckland Harbour Suites, Giapo, King Made Noodles, Smiley Mart, Char Grill, and Mixed 1981. No issues to report.
Full sweep around Gore Street completed. No issues to report.
Fort Street sweep completed. Traffic moving through Fort Street was busy. No further reports.
Walkthrough of High Street completed. Welfare checks completed with no issues reported by stores.
Welfare checks on stores around Chancery Square. No current or prior issues reported.
Welfare sweep along High Street towards Lorne Street completed. No issues to report.
Welfare sweep along Lorne Street completed. No issues reported by local stores.
Heading back to headquarters to prepare for floor checks.
Floor sweeps completed. No issues to report. Ops phone placed on charge while monitoring for response calls.
Ops phone charged. Patrols recommenced to maintain presence along Queen Street.
Queen Street patrol completed with no issues to report. Returned to headquarters for break and guard handover.
Assisted new guard to Metropolis Hotel. No issues.
Proceeding to Ace Nightclub for assistance.
Alcohol removed from two male individuals at Ace Nightclub. No further issues.
Assisted a member of the public who was blocking the road in front of Hazy Tiger. Individual safely guided in the right direction. No further issues.
Welfare check at Bar101. Presence maintained. All clear, no further issues.
Welfare check at Bar101. All clear, no further issues.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:40 – 06:30)
items: Night shift deployed. Equipment received: 4x keys, 2x body cameras, 2x swipe cards, 2x vests, and 1x Ops phone.
Arrived at headquarters. Ops phone placed on charge due to low battery.
Welfare check at Bar101. All clear, no further issues.
Welfare check at Sapphire and nearby carpark. All clear, no further issues.
Welfare check with McDonald's Britomart guards. All clear, no further issues.
Welfare check at Reign & Pour. All clear, no further issues.
Member of the public approached HOTC and stated he was being threatened by a group of minors. He was advised to stay near guards for his safety.
Individual requested a security escort to his ride home once it arrived.
Individual safely escorted to his ride. All clear, no further issues.
Returning to headquarters to charge Ops phone due to low battery.
Arrived at Bar101. Presence maintained until closing.
Welfare check at Bar101. All clear, no further issues.
Patrolling down Queen Street towards Britomart.
Approached by a member of the public needing assistance to locate a specific place. Guards successfully guided them in the right direction.
Arrived at McDonald's Britomart. All clear, no further issues. Commercial Bay area checked.
Commercial Bay all clear. Presence maintained.
Arrived at headquarters office and maintained presence outside the entrance.
30-minute break commenced. Ops phone placed on charge before floor checks.
Response call received from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a vagrant disturbing customers and wanting to fight them.
Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street. Staff advised the vagrant had left willingly after being told security was arriving. Presence maintained.
McDonald's Queen Street all clear, no further issues.
